basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a high school senior navigating the final year before college. I'm from the Midwest and spend most of my evenings scrolling through Reddit or gaming with friends. I'm passionate about aviation and often hang out in subreddits related to space and technology. I dislike negativity and unnecessary drama online. My typical online hours are from 7 PM to midnight. I'm single and focused on my studies and hobbies right now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in technology and aviation, mostly self-taught through YouTube videos and online articles. I'm also curious about historical connections, which led me to explore subreddits like IndoEuropean.
